services.name: Day Of Class
services.desc: New to Gemini? Come experience a gymnastics class and see what makes our programs so special! Our trial classes give your child the opportunity to explore the gym, meet our coaches, learn new skills, and experience gymnastics in a fun and welcoming environment. Once we receive your request, our team will contact you to confirm the trial class time and complete the booking process. Please allow 2-5 business days for us to respond to your request. Your trial class is not confirmed until payment received and you receive a confirmation from our team.Trial classes are not offered during the first or last week of our session. services.desc: JESOLO, ITALY - Gemini Gymnastics sent two of its top athletes, Whitby’s Ana Padurariu and Toronto’s Jade Chrobok, to the world stage to compete for the City of Jesolo Trophy in Italy. The prestigious international gymnastics meet is generally regarded as a gathering of the world’s elite gymnasts in both the junior and senior levels. Padurariu, 14, competed alongside the best gymnasts in the world, including the ultra-dominant Americans as well as the strong teams from Italy, France and Russia.
